keyFindings.description: claudeCodeBlock :376 `[ -d "$cache" ] || rm -f -- "$cache"` runs before the flock under the wrapper's set -eu, and every Claude role of the pod shares one cache. On a cold cache (a new or recreated volume, roles relaunched together), two roles can both see no directory; once one has made it, the other's rm -f fails on the directory and its wrapper exits 1 before npm. That is a charged launch failure. Reproduced in sh: rm -f on the directory prints 'Is a directory' and the subshell exits 1; the control, a cold cache with no race, succeeds. installBlock escapes the same line only because it sits inside its retried `legion_install || legion_install`. Make the cache creation race-safe and add a deterministic test.
